description: Security rules for Kotlin files — prevents SQL injection, hardcoded secrets, and runBlocking in production

rules.description: No SQL built with string interpolation — SQL injection risk
rules.message: SQL built with string interpolation is vulnerable to injection — use parameterized queries

rules.description: Avoid runBlocking in production coroutine code — blocks thread
rules.message: runBlocking blocks the calling thread — use suspend functions or coroutineScope instead

secrets.description: No hardcoded secrets in Kotlin files

rules.description: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords
rules.message: Hardcoded secret detected — use System.getenv() or a secrets manager
